line: Lenovo Legion 5 15 Gen 10 (2025, 15.1" OLED, Arrow Lake-HX refresh)
config_name: Legion 5 15.1 Gen 10 — Core Ultra 9 275HX / RTX 5070 8GB (115W), 32GB DDR5, 1TB SSD, 15.1" WQXGA OLED 165Hz

specs.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Laptop 8GB GDDR7 (115 W TGP incl. Dynamic Boost, MUX)
specs.ports: 2x USB-C 3.2 Gen2 (DP, PD 3.0), 3x USB-A 3.2, HDMI 2.1, RJ45 GbE, 3.5mm

battery.notes: 80 Wh. NBC AMD anchor 9.5h WiFi; HX Intel 'noticeably shorter' — est. ~7h WiFi.

offers.name: Lenovo Legion 5 15.1" WQXGA OLED 165Hz Gaming Laptop - Intel Ultra 9 275HX - 32GB DDR5 - 1TB SSD - GeForce RTX 5070 - Windows 11 - Black

reviews.quote: Thanks to the pre-installed color profiles, even demanding photo and video editing can be done with highly accurate colors. ... Overall, though, there's little to complain about. The Legion 5 15 remains an excellent gaming laptop through and through.

professional.note: NBC reviewed the same 15.1" OLED chassis with RTX 5070 at 32GB (87%). RTINGS/Tom's: no numeric score found, not cited.

praises: The sweet-spot config: 24-core Ultra 9 275HX + 32GB (NBC-tested RAM size) + RTX 5070 115W + the 87%-rated OLED for under $4K on sale
OLED measured 495 nits SDR / 1067 nits HDR with 0.9 deltaE and accurate sRGB/P3 profiles — genuinely creator-capable (NBC)
Dual SODIMM + dual M.2 + screwed battery + Lenovo maintenance manual — the easiest Legion 5 to service
1.94 kg / 21.5 mm, comfortable 1.6 mm-travel keyboard with numpad, Wi-Fi 7 with 1820 MBit/s measured throughput
Fast charging: 80% in 52 min, full in 95 min (NBC on same battery)
complaints: HX-class power draw: ~2.5h less battery than the Ryzen 7 260 model (NBC: Intel 'draws significantly more power ... noticeably shorter battery life')
Fans clearly audible at 50.1 dB(A) in Performance mode (NBC)
No USB4/Thunderbolt on Intel chassis, no card reader (NBC cons)
Glossy-only panel reflects light in bright rooms; PWM flicker listed as con (NBC)
Speakers 'could be better' (NBC); Legion Gen-10 threads report warranty friction, occasional fan-bearing grind and OLED quirks on the platform

design_philosophy: This is the fully-specced expression of Lenovo's mainstream Legion 5 formula: the best CPU option, the RAM size reviewers actually test, full-wattage RTX 5070, and the line's signature 15.1" OLED — serviceable and understated rather than flashy.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from NBC-reviewed 15.1" OLED RTX 5070/32GB configs (87%) per SHARED-legion5-oled.md: +0.2 productivity vs i9-14900HX tier for Arrow Lake-HX 275HX, +0.5 battery vs Raptor-HX tier, 32GB matches tested config (+0.5 productivity / +0.3 ai_ml vs 16GB tiers). Image URL follows standard BBY CDN pattern, not individually verified.
